defects.source_says: Executive Order 9242-A is dated 'September 11,1942' (7 FR 7874, held EO_9242A.txt; the claim's own source signing_date is 1942-09-11 and the U.S. Code note says 'Sept. 11, 1942'). 1939-09-11 predates the order being amended (May 11, 1942).

Executive Order 14085 is 'of October 3, 2022' and signed 'THE WHITE HOUSE, October 3, 2022' (87 FR 60541, held EO_14085.txt; source signing_date 2022-10-03). The date is also inconsistent with the claim's own research_rationale, which gives October 3, 2022.

defects.claim_says: Transfer Order 30 of the Secretary of Defense dated December 10, 1948 is 'a cross-reference whose text is not held'; the 1948 cruden hit is described as a Federal Register concordance page that cites the order as amended; only two held later instruments act on the order
defects.source_says: Held page text jobs/cruden-fr-concordance/output/texts/FR-1948-12-21_p39_734bd5b6ca34.txt (13 FR 8163, PDF page 39 of FR 1948-12-21; returned by the cruden number search) is Transfer Order 30 itself: Secretary of Defense James Forrestal, dated December 10, 1948, 'effective as of 12:00 noon, December 10,1948', transferring to the Secretary of the Air Force the functions relating to decorations vested in the Secretary of the Army under, among others, item k, 'Executive Order No. 9158 of May 11, 1942 (7 F. R. 3541), as amended by Execu-tive Order No. 9242-A of September 11, 1942 (7 F. R. 7874)'. It is a transfer of functions, not an ending. Its text is held, so the search description is inaccurate, and this held later instrument changing who exercises the second paragraph's award authority is not recorded as a later event.

reasoning: Identity (EO 9158, Air Medal, Roosevelt, May 11, 1942, F. R. Doc. 42-4314, 7 FR 3541) and the one-clause inventory are correct; quotes and hashes match. Continuation is supported: the U.S. Code note prints the order as amended by EO 9242-A and EO 14085 with no ending, no held FR catalog note revokes or supersedes it, and no own-terms end exists. The claim is rejected because both later events carry wrong effective dates (1939-09-11 and 2019-10-03 for instruments dated 1942-09-11 and 2022-10-03), and because it states that Transfer Order 30's text is not held when the held 13 FR 8163 page is that order, which transferred Army award functions under EO 9158 to the Secretary of the Air Force effective noon December 10, 1948; that transfer is not an end but is an unrecorded later event. The EO 14085 mechanism description matches sections 1(a)-(c).
